title: Agent app instances launch off-screen, not on the user monitor
description: Agent-launched Electron instances (desktop suite + app:isolated) hijacked the primary monitor: the splash is alwaysOnTop+centred and the main window show()s with focus. Under CUBRIC_E2E / CUBRIC_BACKGROUND there is now no splash and the window is parked below every monitor with showInactive(). Minimizing was tried first and rejected: a minimized window does not composite on Windows (2 fps, stalled CSS transitions, one failed toast spec).
